name: Organizational leadership and executives
description: Senior leaders responsible for setting strategic direction and making high-level decisions.

name: Department and agency heads
description: Managers who oversee operational execution and align departmental goals with organizational vision.

name: Policy makers and legislators
description: Individuals who create and enforce laws and policies that impact the organization’s mandate and activities.

name: Employees and internal teams
description: Staff members who implement strategies and deliver services aligned with organizational goals.

name: Community members and constituents
description: The public and groups served by the organization, whose needs and feedback shape strategic relevance.

name: Partner organizations and collaborators
description: External entities that work collaboratively with the organization to achieve shared objectives.

name: Industry and sector experts
description: Specialists providing domain knowledge, technical insights, and guidance relevant to the organization's mission.

name: Advocacy and interest groups
description: Organizations representing specific causes or constituencies that influence strategic priorities and decision-making.
